item.title: Should the U.S. have a mandatory retirement age?
item.description: Older workers are delaying retirement more and more. But it's causing younger workers to wonder if they're missing out on job advancement because senior roles aren't opening up. Is this true?
item.content:encoded: Older workers are delaying retirement more and more. But it's causing younger workers to wonder if they're missing out on job advancement because senior roles aren't opening up. Is this true?
item.dc:creator: Sarah Gonzalez

item.title: At Big Bend National Park, bulldozers begin clearing land for border barrier work
item.description: In the Big Bend area of West Texas, contractors are beginning to set the stage to build the Trump administration's planned border wall and barriers, despite bipartisan opposition.
item.content:encoded: In the Big Bend area of West Texas, contractors are beginning to set the stage to build the Trump administration's planned border wall and barriers, despite bipartisan opposition.
item.dc:creator: Carlos Morales

item.title: No privacy, little downtime: Life aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: Almost 5,000 sailors have spent months aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. As another carrier heads to relieve them, a former pilot takes us inside life on the ship.
item.content:encoded: Almost 5,000 sailors have spent months aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. As another carrier heads to relieve them, a former pilot takes us inside life on the ship.
item.dc:creator: Kai McNamee

item.title: As speed cameras spread to more states, so does the backlash from drivers
item.description: Millions of drivers across the country are encountering speed cameras for the first time, or will soon. Some don't like it, but advocates say there's clear evidence that cameras make roads safer.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Mangione pleads guilty in federal court, leaving fate of state trial uncertain
item.description: Mangione has pleaded guilty to stalking charges in connection with the death of Brian Thompson, a health care executive. A separate judge will decide the future of Mangione's state trial.

item.title: Reports about mental health, supply issues aboard USS Lincoln raise concerns
item.description: The USS Lincoln has been at sea since late last year, part of the administration's war with Iran. Military families are worried about the conditions sailors are living under.

item.title: ICE uses controversial program to boost deportations. Here's how it works in 1 county
